    Source-linked and version-aware

    Sources & live help

    Reference baseline

    Reference reviewed . Each source below records its own scope and freshness. Source snapshots and online documentation do not establish every installed or hosted behavior.

    Counts measure reference entries. Some entries group related controls.

    Open and maintain the guide

    Open docs/agent-guide.html in a browser from this clone. On GitHub, download the raw HTML first. Everything needed for the interface is embedded; source links use the network only when selected.

    Search works across action names, commands, modes and details. Stars and theme are browser-local; they do not sync between hosts. Export/import saved keys transfers favorites explicitly. Print view includes the current results and their context.
    Guide sources and rebuild instructions: docs/agent-guide-src/README.md. Regenerate with make agent-guide; make check rejects stale HTML.
    AI-client control and workflow changes include guide reconciliation here. The generator checks file consistency; source and live-help review establish the documented controls.
